promptTemplates.cartoon: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium, polished realistic-cartoon 3D wildlife illustration of exactly one {animal}. Preserve believable species anatomy, natural surface texture, and defining features while giving the animal a friendly, curious presence without humanizing it. Show the full body in {habitat}, vertical 2:3 game-card composition, clean silhouette, cinematic soft natural light, no other animals, people, text, logo, watermark, border, collage, costumes, chibi proportions, fantasy features, crops, or duplicate limbs.
promptTemplates.realistic: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a high-end wildlife photograph of exactly one {animal}, with true species anatomy, realistic surface detail, and every defining feature visible. Show the full body in {habitat}, vertical 2:3 game-card composition, natural environmental light, no other animals, people, text, logo, watermark, border, collage, fantasy features, crops, or duplicate limbs.
